summary: CORS fix verification for auth exception handlers. Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: all 3 auth flows (guest, wrong password, valid login) now working correctly after clearing stale metro cache. Root cause of frontend failures was stale metro cache containing old bharti-justice.preview.emergentagent.com URL baked into bundle - fixed by clearing cache and restarting Expo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py lines 144-189: Both @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) and @app.exception_handler(Exception) now correctly include Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * headers. Fix is correct.

STALE METRO CACHE ISSUE (fixed by T1): Metro cache under /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache had bundled files with old bharti-justice.preview.emergentagent.com baked into the manifest JSON. app.config.js correctly reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env at bundle time but stale cache prevented this. Cleared cache and restarted Expo to fix.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3) - guest login, wrong password error, valid login all work

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flows fully verified. CORS fix is working: 401/422/500 responses all carry Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * header. Guest login works. Valid login navigates to home screen. Wrong password shows clean 'Invalid credentials' message. Metro cache was cleared - if Expo is restarted again, it will rebuild correctly from .env. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_cors_fix.py for regression.
rca_of_issue: PRIMARY BUG (fixed by E1): exception_handler responses for RequestValidationError and bare Exception in server.py were missing CORS headers, causing browsers to block cross-origin error responses silently - client saw 'Could not start guest session' even though backend was working. FIX: added headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', ...} to both exception handler JSONResponse returns. SECONDARY ISSUE (fixed by T1 during testing): Metro cache contained stale bundle files with old bharti-justice.preview.emergentagent.com URL baked in. apiBase.ts reads extra.backendUrl from Constants.expoConfig first (which came from stale cached bundle manifest) over EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var. After clearing /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache and restarting Expo, frontend correctly targets dhara-shield-2.preview.emergentagent.com.
